title: Mars Outpost Power and Communication Recovery
subtitle: Solar Generation Restoration, Outpost Power Recovery and Communication Repair
description: Restore the outpost power system following the Sol 7 dust storm, repair both solar panels and the main solar power connection, restore the main supply through the existing Engineering Power Unit, and independently recover the outdoor communication system. Preserve all previous Sol progress, observations, evidence, sample identity and cultivation records.

interfaces.resolution: Reuse the existing Engineering screens and Power Unit interaction.
Use the existing Mission Control systems interface.
Use the shared EVA suit preparation system.

interfaces.location: Existing Mars terrain Solar Panel A repair point
interfaces.resolution: Use the named existing terrain interaction.

interfaces.location: Existing Mars terrain Solar Panel B repair point
interfaces.resolution: Use the named existing terrain interaction.

interfaces.location: Existing Mars terrain main solar connection repair point
interfaces.resolution: Use the named existing terrain interaction.

interfaces.location: Existing Mars terrain communication repair point
interfaces.resolution: Preserve the supplied trigger spelling and use the loaded terrain object.

interfaces.location: Existing Mission Control main operations console
interfaces.resolution: Reuse the existing Mission Control report interface.

tasks.title: Review Critical Power Failure Alert
tasks.objective: Review the critical low-reserve power alert, acknowledge the power emergency and understand the temporary reserve-power condition.
tasks.completionCondition: The player reviews and acknowledges the active Sol 8 Power Failure warning.

tasks.title: Inspect Engineering Power Unit
tasks.objective: Open the existing Engineering Power Unit interface and inspect reserve power, solar generation, panel status, main solar connection and power distribution.
tasks.completionCondition: The Power Unit assessment is recorded, the low-reserve warning is acknowledged, and the three outdoor repair requirements are identified.

tasks.title: Inspect Communication System Failure
tasks.objective: Inspect the existing Mission Control communication interface, record the offline communication status and identify the outdoor communication repair requirement.
tasks.completionCondition: The communication failure is diagnosed and recorded without clearing or repairing it.

tasks.title: Prepare for External Power Repairs
tasks.objective: Use the existing Airlock and global EVA system to equip the EVA suit and prepare for authorized outdoor repair operations.
tasks.completionCondition: The existing EVA system confirms that the player is equipped and authorized for the outdoor repair sequence.

tasks.title: Restore Solar Panel A
tasks.objective: Reach the existing Solar Panel A repair interaction and complete the required repair using the existing trigger.
tasks.completionCondition: The existing PowerUnit_A interaction confirms successful repair and records Solar Panel A as operational.

tasks.title: Restore Solar Panel B
tasks.objective: Reach the existing Solar Panel B repair interaction and complete the required repair using the existing trigger.
tasks.completionCondition: The existing PowerUnit_B interaction confirms successful repair and records Solar Panel B as operational.

tasks.title: Repair Main Solar Power Connection
tasks.objective: Repair the main outdoor solar power connection that links the two solar panels to the outpost power system.
tasks.completionCondition: The existing PowerUnit_AB_Main interaction confirms that the main solar connection is repaired and records it as operational.

tasks.title: Restore Main Outpost Power Supply
tasks.objective: Return to the existing Engineering Power Unit interface, verify Solar Panel A, Solar Panel B and the main solar connection, then restore the main outpost supply.
tasks.completionCondition: The Power Unit validates all three repair states, confirms main power restoration, clears only the Power Failure state, fades out the power warning beep and restores the configured emergency light objects to their original active state.

tasks.title: Verify Outpost Power Recovery
tasks.objective: Verify restored solar generation, main power supply, reserve status, power distribution and the removal of the Power Failure warning from all relevant physical 3D screens.
tasks.completionCondition: Power recovery is verified and recorded. Communication Failure remains active and its warning remains visible.

tasks.title: Restore Outdoor Communication System
tasks.objective: Reach the existing outdoor communication repair interaction and restore the communication system using the supplied trigger.
tasks.completionCondition: The existing communication repair interaction confirms successful restoration and records the communication system as online.

tasks.title: Verify Recovery and Submit Mission Report
tasks.objective: Verify power and communication recovery independently, confirm that both corresponding warnings are cleared, and submit the Sol 8 recovery report.
tasks.completionCondition: All mandatory repair and verification records are present, both failure states are resolved, and the final report validates.

objectives.title: Acknowledge Critical Power Failure
objectives.completionCondition: The active low-reserve power alert is reviewed and acknowledged.

objectives.title: Assess Engineering Power Unit
objectives.completionCondition: The player records the current Power Unit condition and identifies all required repair stages.

objectives.title: Diagnose Communication Failure
objectives.completionCondition: The communication fault is identified and recorded. It remains unresolved.

objectives.title: Complete EVA Preparation
objectives.completionCondition: The existing EVA system confirms suit preparation and outdoor access authorization.

objectives.title: Repair Solar Panel A
objectives.completionCondition: Solar Panel A repair is confirmed by the existing trigger interaction.

objectives.title: Repair Solar Panel B
objectives.completionCondition: Solar Panel B repair is confirmed by the existing trigger interaction.

objectives.title: Repair Main Solar Connection
objectives.completionCondition: The main outdoor solar connection repair is confirmed by the existing trigger interaction.

objectives.title: Restore Main Power Supply
objectives.completionCondition: All three repair states are verified and the existing Engineering Power Unit confirms main power restoration.

objectives.title: Verify Power Recovery
objectives.completionCondition: Power Failure warning is removed, power beep fades to silence, configured lights return to their captured original state, and communication warning remains active.

objectives.title: Repair Communication System
objectives.completionCondition: The existing outdoor communication repair trigger confirms that communication is online.

objectives.title: Submit Recovery Report
objectives.completionCondition: Power and communication recovery are independently verified and the report passes validation.

powerFailureConfiguration.startCondition: Activate when the existing mission lifecycle starts PHOBOSIA_SOL_08.

warning.title: CRITICAL POWER FAILURE
warning.message: Main solar generation is unavailable. The outpost is operating on limited reserve power. Restore both solar panels and the main solar connection, then reactivate the main supply through the Engineering Power Unit.

communicationFailureConfiguration.startCondition: Activate when the existing mission lifecycle starts PHOBOSIA_SOL_08.

warning.title: COMMUNICATION SYSTEM OFFLINE
warning.message: The outpost communication system is offline. Inspect Mission Control diagnostics and restore the external communication system.

powerTriggers.target: Main solar power connection linking both panels to the outpost power unit
